about.title: Direct. Discreet. Dubai.
about.body: Operating privately from Dubai, we offer a curated line of Seiko Mod skeleton timepieces — built on Japanese TMI movements in luxury-sport cases with exhibition case backs. Every piece is inspected before it ships. No showroom, no middlemen — just direct conversation.

policy.title: Terms
policy.subtitle: Please read before you buy.
policy.b1Body: All sales are final. Each watch is inspected, wound, and confirmed working before dispatch. Returns and refunds are not accepted.
policy.b2Body: I am a private individual, not a retail establishment. No storefront, no warranty desk — direct sale only.
policy.b3Body: Free tracked shipping worldwide. The buyer is responsible for any import duties or taxes in the destination country.

w1.description: TMI NH72A automatic with hand-winding and stop-second. Blackened bridges and dark rubies. Black PVD/DLC case and integrated bracelet. Skeleton dial with exhibition case back. 24 jewels · 21,600 vph · ~41h power reserve.

w2.description: TMI NH70A automatic with hand-winding and stop-second. Stainless steel case and integrated bracelet — brushed and polished. Skeleton dial with exhibition case back. 24 jewels · 21,600 vph · ~41h power reserve.

w3.description: TMI NH71A automatic with hand-winding and stop-second. Gold-plated bridges and rotor. Gold PVD case and integrated bracelet. Skeleton dial with exhibition case back. 24 jewels · 21,600 vph · ~41h power reserve.
